title: Rabbi Shmuel bar Yose
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman gives this name in Kiddushin 33a for the sage who objected to Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi. He calls it a textual error and proposes Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Yose.

The older Midrash Tehillim, chapter 3, likewise has Rabbi Shmuel, son of Rabbi Yose, seeking to expound this book before his teacher. Hyman proposes Rabbi Yishmael, son of Rabbi Yose, as in the Yalkut there, section 624.

notes.text: The change from Shmuel to Yishmael is Hyman’s correction; the full father’s name Yose controls the abbreviated second occurrence.

In the consulted Kiddushin 33a, Shimon son of Rabbi is offended when Bar Kappara, alternatively Rabbi Shmuel son of Rabbi Yose, does not stand for him. Hyman’s wording presents the objection differently. His proposed Yishmael reading is retained as his correction, not a verified replacement of the consulted reading.
